dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Look. You've got some weird frame of reference, okay? We took 'em out together with a joint move, and you're taking all the credit for it?

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: 'Tis known in all the corners of the City in all of its vastness, elevation, and depth—the warrior who hath pierced the heart last taketh the final glory and credit! Fair is fair, wouldst thou not say?

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: I beseech thee to consider this counterpoint mine. Recall our slaying of the second foe: despite my spear pulverizing the bones of its limbs quadruple and hips painful, 'twas thou who had delivered the final blow by piercing its throat, was it not?

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: ... Okay, and?

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Continue the search within thy recollection, and thou may recall that I deigned to defer that glory mine to thee; in short, 'twas a fair and just accrediting of glory to thee, for thine was the thrust that put an end to its lifebreath!

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: ... And the rest of them—four, in fact—I pretty much left them hanging by a thread for you to swoop in and finish them off.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: ... *cough*

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: But guess what? I was going to report that we took down 2.5 targets each. I didn't even stop to consider the alternative, because why would I? We did the job together, didn't we?

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: And now you wanna insist on picking things apart? You wanna nickel and dime this?

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Prithee, acquaint thyself with the old maxim that the heart groweth the more its master giveth!

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Yeah, growing. Wouldn't that be nice. It still feels so weird swinging these weapons with these stubby limbs...

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: ... 'T-twas but—

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Watch yourself, huh? Don Quixote.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Hnnnh... V-verily, I understand!
Two children, each wielding a rather sizable spear, were pitter-pattering across the wet floor.

From a bird's-eye view, it looked as though someone had spilled a bucketful of red paint over a rusted metal plate.
If red paint could curdle into a dark brown color as it oxidized, that is.

The two were surrounded by bodies they skewered and tore through together, but nothing in that sight held an ounce of interest for the two as they were far too busy bickering and arguing with each other.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: *sigh* Didn't I spell it out for you back then? Clearly and coherently, too. You need to check the box for the growth shots add-on for me or I'll get the same body I had cloned when I signed up for the insurance... Which was a damn while ago.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Forsooth, thou hast brought this matter up over 40 times since...

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: ... And if we were to count since the incident, today would mark the 35th time thou hast harrowed mine ears with—

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Oh yeah? Harrowing your ears, am I?

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: N-nay, of course not!
... Perhaps "bickering" is too generous a word; it seems fairer to say that the passive-aggressive bursts of frustration were quite one-sided.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Man... How long have we been fighting side-by-side now? Do we really need to keep going over stuff like this? That damn leech tagging along is already getting on my last nerve, and I don't need you adding to it.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Then perchance thou needst not allow this awful talk of insurance to haunt thy mind...?

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Oh, come on!

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Ahem...

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: *sigh* Forget it, it's no use crying over spilled milk, anyway.
With all the frustration spent, the child let out a defeated sigh and slumped onto a metal stool he dragged from nearby.
The Office rep was going to rendezvous with them here anyway, so he wasn't in any rush.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: I really don't gel with that guy, you know...?

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Did you see him go from moping around, all depressed, to self-righteous moralizing at the drop of a hat? ... Did we tell him off, heaping all the blame on his head? No! All we said was we don't want to accept him at our Office because he won't be a good fit.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Hm... 'Tis true, indeed. We spoke no falsehood, but neither did we wrap it in velvet, did we?

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: I daresay the young man is under quite the palpable pressure! 'Tis only natural that even the teensiest prick would burst the proverbial dam.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Ah, this bringeth to mind how thou— *cough* Never thou mind. I fear I may be putting my cranium at risk by continuing this line of thought.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: ... Did you just compare me to a punk like him?

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Hoyday! Perish the thought, perish it.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Whatever. I just don't think people like him are built for this line of work. Being a Fixer, I mean. I'm sure he's been hearing nothing but nice things about him, because that's just the way the City is. Full of people trembling in their boots because they might piss off the wrong, unassuming guy in the streets.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: "I'd never let a Fixer like you join my Office. You'd give us a bad name and trip us up." Sure, it's not a nice thing to say, but it's also an invitation to read between the lines, improve himself, and— Ugh, I just don't like him.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Ah! I see how it is, young Sinclair. I recognize it!

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Though thy tongue speaketh contempt... deeper within the cages of thy ribs beateth a heart most caring for that young man's plight!

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: ... Do you have an inexplicable need to get punched in the face?

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: I take offense to that! I was simply— In other words— Mm, indeed. Merely attempting to... gauge what lieth in the depth of thy person!

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: I could almost see the gears turning in your head to come up with that lame excuse.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Hm, hm hm.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: No matter; I beseech thee to think like a Citizen, that is, like a Fixer.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: I see little reason for thee to concern thyself with him until thy temper frayeth so.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: He is but a transient stranger, to be out of our sights and minds once this task is behind us. So long as he bringeth us no grief, it would be of no concern nor consequence to us whether he perisheth or thriveth.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: And if he doth bring us grief... Well, the lady shall stab him dead afore either of us even grabeth our spears.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Ah, now I reminisce upon my past, in which I harbored naught but blind adoration for the Fixers. I had once believed Fixers to be paragons of justice, armed with the virtue of loyalty... Alas, I was quickly dispelled of that notion.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: I had never once imagined I would be—as you put it—nickel-and-diming my share.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: ... All that once seemed noble was but a façade, every act of justice weighed upon the scales of profit margins. In the end, no "professional" Fixer is driven by such emotional fervor.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: No shit. I'm not trusting an emotion-driven wreck like him to watch my back in a battle.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Indeed. I know that quite well myself.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: I know that nothing is more selfish than to act solely in a way one sees as just.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: ... He's buying into his own deception, that's what. That's where all of his moralizing comes from, wrapped in pretty words alone. He doesn't even understand how much harm he's causing to everyone around...

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Hmm hmm, thou speaketh true, indeed...!

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: ... Hold on. What's up with that patronizing tone you've suddenly picked up? Are you some kinda guru now? You know all the answers to life's questions, huh?

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Hnngh... Thou'rt a wily one, scurrying from one subject to the next when on an intellectual back foot...!
... What is selflessness?
The leader of these two children often insists that there is no such thing as selflessness in this world, only delusional selfishness that mistakes itself for altruism.
And I do agree with that.
Perhaps that child's irate tantrums house what people commonly term "selflessness."

The child's words may have sounded like annoyance; he says that he would prefer the "punk" not to cause his Office further grief... But words are only layers that mask our intent. Beneath it all, the child hopes that the young man will stop going down this self-destructive path. Beneath it all, he is concerned for the young man.
Even that, however, must amount to no more than another form of selfishness that demands he give voice to the thoughts that arise in his mind.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Rep
dataList.content: Hm. All present, I see.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Ah, you're here.
The child rises from the stool, dusting off his clothes to greet a distant figure wielding a spear much like their own.
Closely following is another figure, this one wearing a gray jacket and an expression just as colorless and grim.
... Like a swirling pit of vengeance and anxiety personified.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: As thou hast commanded, we have completed our final quest, felling a grand total of five foes! Two of which were felled by young Sinclair, and the remaining three vanquished handily by none other than myself.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Again, what the hell's wrong with your math?! It's 2.5 each!

dataList.title: Wedge Office Rep
dataList.content: You two don't ever get tired of this squabbling, do you?

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: ... Hey, someone shit on your breakfast? Stop frowning already, would you?

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: He recovereth still. Prithee, give the boy quarter.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Forsooth, thou needst not latch onto another opportunity to change the subject.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: ... I swear, once we're back in the Office...

The child glared at the other child, his teeth audibly grinding, but it wasn't long before he decided to let all that anger dissipate through a deep, resigned sigh. He looked at the two latecomers as though he were anticipating something.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: Well, then our next destination should be...

dataList.title: Wedge Office Rep
dataList.content: Correct. The Library.

dataList.title: Wedge Office Rep
dataList.content: Get your wits about you, everyone. As always, whoever it is...

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: ... as soon as you get in our way,

dataList.title: Wedge Office Fixer
dataList.content: we shall skewer thee clean!
The Invitation flutters for a moment before shimmering as though it were surrounded by a heat haze—and the children are transported to an unfamiliar environment.
And to the children who will soon find themselves characters in a tale, I would say...
Ah yes, of course. That child would say...
"May you find your book in this place."
